_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/faces/test_return_face_down.py. t_rfd_phoenix is Ashcloud Phoenix's 'when this dies, return it to the battlefield face down under your control' on a morph creature. t_rfd_husk is the same trigger on a creature with no morph, so a test can show it never turns up. t_rfd_raptor is Deathmist Raptor's 'whenever a permanent you control is turned face up, you may return this card from your graveyard face up or face down' on a megamorph creature. t_rfd_watcher hears a face-down creature enter.
